confidence_notes: Meals and coffee are informed by [July 2026 prices](https://www.expatarrivals.com/americas/argentina/cost-living-argentina) and a later [Numbeo update](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Buenos-Aires). Cocktail and wine estimates use [local drink guidance](https://www.buenosairestourism.org/best-bars-in-buenos-aires/): a cocktail is roughly twice the beer price and a glass of wine somewhat more than beer. Peso volatility and venue variation limit accuracy; accommodation figures are less certain holistic estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Dining estimates use Buenos Aires data. Accommodation estimates use a broad comparison with major South American capitals such as Santiago, adjusted for Buenos Aires tourism demand and July seasonality.
